name: Using the tools
description: Whether the assistant reaches for the right tool: searching inside workspace files, changing a file with a patch, and reading a page in the browser.

tasks.prompt: Create a workspace file named eval-haystack.txt whose only line is "the needle is in here". Then search the workspace for the word needle and tell me which file contains it.
Create a workspace file named eval-patch.txt whose only line is "one". Then apply a patch that changes that line to "two". Then say patched.
Open the local page at http://127.0.0.1:8099/eval.html in the browser and tell me the text of its main heading.
